title: US passport structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of passport candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the Swift ``detectPassports`` regex at PIIDetector.swift:668 (pattern declared at :663-666).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one passport candidate with its expected structural verdict.

passport_number.description: The number portion (regex capture group 1 for valid vectors).

valid.description: Whether the candidate matches the Swift passport regex shape.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this passport, or null if valid.
